G1103.definition: (γίγνομαι),  ; 1. prop., lawfully begotten, born in wedlock (in π., γυνὴ γ., a lawful wife; MM, see word). ; 2. true, genuine, sincere: Php.4:3, 1Ti.1:2, Tit.1:4; as subst., τὸ γ. = ἡ γνησιότης, sincerity, 2Co.8:8.; † (AS)

G1104.definition: sincerely, honourably: Phi 2:20 (for a parallel in π., see MM, see word).†; (AS)

G1128.definition: (γυμνός),  ; 1. properly, to exercise naked. ; 2. Generally, to exercise, train the body or mind: 1Ti.4:7, Heb.5:14 12:11, 2Pe.2:14.; † (AS)

G1167.definition: (δειλός),  ; cowardice, timidity (never in good sense): 2Ti.1:7.†; SYN.: φόβος, fear, in general, good or bad; εὐλάβεια (which see), apprehension generally, but chiefly pious fear, "that careful and watchful reverence which pays regard to every circumstance in that with which it has to deal" (cf. Tr., Syn., § x).† (AS)

G1133.definition: a little woman; contemptuously, a silly woman (EV): 2Ti.3:6.†; (AS)

G1114.definition: 1. a wailer. ; 2. a wizard. ; 3. an impostor (cf. γοητεία, trickery, 2Ma.12:24): 2Ti.3:13.; † (AS)

G1149.definition: Dalmatia, a part of Illyria on E. coast of the Adriatic: 2Ti.4:10.†; (AS)

G1181.definition: a tenth part, a tithe: Heb.7:2, 4; 8, 9 (for a curious inversion of the Biblical use, see MM, see word).†; (AS)

G1183.definition: = cl. -τεύω (δεκάτη),  ; to take tithe of: with accusative of person(s), Heb.7:6; pass. to pay tithe: Heb.7:9.†; (AS)

G1151.definition: (fem. of δαμάλης, a bullock),  ; a heifer, Heb.9:13.†; (AS)

G1192.definition: (δέρω),  ; the skin, hide of beasts: ἐν αἰγίοις δ., Heb.11:37.†; (AS)

G1105.definition: darkness, gloom (including "an element of tempest," Tr., Syn., §with): Heb.12:18.†; SYN.: ἀχλύς, ζόφος, σκότος (Tr., l.with; DB, i, 457a). (AS)

G1185.definition: (δέλεαρ, a bait), ; to allure by a bait: metaphorically, to allure, entice: with accusative, 2Pe.2:14, 18; pass., Jas.1:14.†; (AS)

G1164.definition: (δείκνυμι); 1. (cl.) a thing shown, a specimen. ; 2. = cl. παράδ- (cf. ὑπόδ-, 2Pe.2:6), an example (a warning): Ju 7.† ; (AS)
